story_title: A Week of Better Food Choices
paragraphs: On Sunday evening, Nora meets her friend Daniel to plan simple meals for the week. Daniel wants to eat more vegetables, so they look through a recipe book. "If we {{mask_1}} a meal plan tonight, we {{mask_2}} less time deciding what to cook," Nora says. Daniel points to a lentil soup recipe. "If we {{mask_3}} the ingredients tomorrow, we {{mask_4}} the soup for lunch."

They make a shopping list and check what is already in the kitchen. Nora says, "If we {{mask_5}} the list at the market, we {{mask_6}} only what we need." Daniel notices that they have no fresh fruit. "If I {{mask_7}} apples and oranges, we {{mask_8}} them with breakfast." They also choose plain yogurt and oats for quick snacks.
